verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform documents building automated apps and integrations that run inside servers. Bots can receive Gateway events and post messages via webhooks, which supports background, event-driven automation. However, automation depends on a developer building and hosting a bot or app; the evidence shows no user-facing way to set up automations. Missing for 10: no-code or user-configurable automation setup, scheduled or recurring triggers, documented background execution hosted by Discord, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Build automated apps, commands, and integrations that run inside Discord servers.
The Gateway API lets apps open secure WebSocket connections with Discord to receive events about actions that take place in a server/guild, like when a channel is updated or a role is created.
CI/CD pipelines posting build results or deployment notifications
